answer.effective_date: Last revision shown in an Ambetter/Centene copy: 04/2025. The North Carolina webpage lists CP.MP.114 as an active policy, but the effective or last-revised date of the specific North Carolina copy could not be independently verified.
criteria_quotes: It is the policy of health plans affiliated with Centene Corporation® that open discectomy and microdiscectomy are medically necessary when meeting all of the following:
Nerve root compression confirmed by imaging and one of the following:
The denial notice states that the submitted records did not document an "adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery."
answer.appeal_deadline: 2027-02-03. The notice states that the appeal must be received within 180 days of 2026-08-07.
answer.submission_route: Submit a member appeal in writing using Ambetter of North Carolina's member Grievance, Appeal, Concern or Recommendation Form: https://www.ambetterhealth.com/content/dam/centene/ambetternc/pdfs/NC-MbrGrievanceApealConcrn.pdf. Mail the appeal and supporting records to: Ambetter of North Carolina Inc., 1701 North Graham St, Suite 101, Charlotte, NC 28206. For assistance with the appeal process, call Member Services at 1-833-863-1310 (Relay 711). Identify reference number POC-EE22487639-86426 and request confirmation of receipt.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: The Ambetter of North Carolina clinical-policy page identifies CP.MP.114 as the applicable policy and states that its clinical policies apply to Ambetter of North Carolina members: https://www.ambetterhealth.com/en/nc/provider-resources/clinical-payment-policies/. The publicly available PDF could not be text-extracted in this review, and the denial letter does not identify the exact policy revision or any InterQual criteria. Ask Ambetter Member Services or Medical Management, in writing and by phone, for the complete criteria actually applied to this authorization, including the specific revision/date, any InterQual criteria or delegated-vendor guideline used, and the records or documentation considered insufficient. The plan page instructs members to ask Member Services to be directed to Medical Management.
answer.notes: Ambetter of North Carolina's public policy page lists CP.MP.114, Disc Decompression Procedures, and states that all policies in its clinical-policy manual apply to Ambetter of North Carolina members. The available policy copy identifies CPT 63030-type open/microdiscectomy criteria, including adult age, herniated lumbar-disc diagnosis, imaging-confirmed nerve-root compression, and clinical neurologic or radicular findings. I could not verify from the retrieved material the complete conservative-treatment wording or the exact effective date of the North Carolina version. Do not assume that the publicly posted copy is the exact revision used for this denial; request that revision directly from Ambetter.
